definitions.gloss: painting; coating; applying paint or finish
definitions.explanation: The act or result of applying paint or protective coating to a surface, typically for cars, buildings, or industrial products.

examples.japanese: {車|くるま}の{塗装|とそう}が{剥|は}げてきた。
examples.english: The paint on my car is starting to peel.

examples.japanese: {外壁|がいへき}の{塗装|とそう}{工事|こうじ}を{依頼|いらい}した。
examples.english: I requested exterior wall painting work.

examples.japanese: この{塗装|とそう}は{防水|ぼうすい}{効果|こうか}がある。
examples.english: This coating has a waterproofing effect.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{塗装|とそう}する (to paint, to coat)
・{塗装|とそう}{工事|こうじ} (painting work/job)
・{塗装|とそう}{業者|ぎょうしゃ} (painting contractor)
・{再|さい}{塗装|とそう} (repainting)

TYPES OF PAINTING:
・{外壁|がいへき}{塗装|とそう} (exterior wall painting)
・{車両|しゃりょう}{塗装|とそう} (vehicle painting)
・{防錆|ぼうせい}{塗装|とそう} (rust-proof coating)

RELATED CONSTRUCTION TERMS:
・{内装|ないそう} (interior finishing)
・{外装|がいそう} (exterior finishing)
